## apiome auth {#auth}

Inspect signed-in identity and accessible tenants.

```text
apiome auth [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`status`](#auth-status), [`tenants`](#auth-tenants), [`whoami`](#auth-whoami).

## apiome auth status {#auth-status}

Alias for ``auth whoami`` (GET /v1/tenants/me).

```text
apiome auth status [OPTIONS]
```

## apiome auth tenants {#auth-tenants}

List tenants accessible to the caller (GET /v1/tenants/me).

```text
apiome auth tenants [OPTIONS]
```

## apiome auth whoami {#auth-whoami}

Show accessible tenant membership (GET /v1/tenants/me).

```text
apiome auth whoami [OPTIONS]
```
